title: Nest Protect CO Self-Test Miss
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nestprotect:event event=self_test
| stats max(days_since_last_test) as days_since_last_test by device
| where days_since_last_test>30
| sort - days_since_last_test
description: Uses Nest Protect self-test events telemetry to monitor how long each unit has gone without a self-test in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for life-safety devices that are drifting past expected checks, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nest Protect self-test events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Device table of days since last self-test.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long each unit has gone without a self-test so you can spot life-safety devices that are drifting past expected checks before it becomes annoying.
